name: classes-m8-munchkin
description: better-borg-c M8 and the borg-rs Rust port at M8 on classes-1800, default settings only. Both specimens' default already bakes in the munchkin start by class (M8 carries that as part of its change set), so adding the munchkin-wdr profile here would re-measure the same games: a smoke test on 2026-11-09 found identical play/trace hashes on 3/3 seeds for both.
